<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0032026-09-1705-04-57" status="unreviewed">'o na mngon sum la bcad pa'i shes pa yod de sngon 'dzin mig shes kyi blo rgyun phyi ma lta bu yin la | rjes dpag la bcad shes yod dam <lb n="9b1"/> ce na 
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3840">kha 1</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3840">dan</rs></note> na ‹re› yod de de ltar ma yin na rtags las dngos su rtogs pa rjes dpag yin nam rtags kyi stobs kyis rtogs pas kyang go chod pa yin | 
         dang po ltar na rjes dpag gi shus rtogs rjes dpag du mi 'gyur la | 
         gnyis pa ltar na rjes dpag la bcad shes yod de du ba'i rtags las la me ldan du rtogs pa'i blo rgyun phyi ma kun rjes dpag bcad shes yin te rtags <lb n="9b2"/> kyi stobs kyis rtogs zin ‹gyi don› la 'jug pa'i phyir ro || 
         des na rjes dpag tsam gyi mtshan nyid ni tshul 3 rtags las don shes yin la | rjes dpag tshad ma'i mtshan nyid ni tshul 3 pa'i rtags las rtogs pa'i chos 3 dang ldan pa yin no || rjes dpag bcad shes kyi mtshan nyid ni tshul 3 pa'i rtags las sngar rtogs zin gyi don la sgro 'dogs dang 'gal bar 'jug pa'o <lb n="9b3"/> zhes zer ba ni 
         ma yin te |</seg></TEI>
